claims.claim: !clip and !createclip create a clip in a live stream; the channel cooldown is 10 seconds.
Offline, !clip answers with a short no-stream notice (one of several German texts).
Clip duration is configurable from 5 to 60 seconds in the dashboard, default 60.
A title after !clip names the clip, long titles are truncated with '...', and an empty title gets a fallback title.
!vodclip takes minutes or h:m:s, range 1 to 10 minutes.
!vodclip download is an MP4 up to 64 MiB, available for 24 hours.
!vodclip is limited to broadcaster and mods and requires an active partner channel and the dashboard switch.
!clipcontest requires an own-channel partner clip, up to 3 submissions per channel per Berlin day, no double counting.

claims.claim: Community hint on the Deutsche Deadlock Community Discord is on by default; from Netzwerk Plus it can be switched off in the dashboard.
Abo-Erinnerung is only written when a viewer enables it with !sub erinnerung an and the streamer has enabled the feature.
Follow hint and greeting are dashboard switches; greeting is off by default; follow hint excludes mods, broadcaster and commands.
Twitch re-authorization reminder is sent at go-live (stream went live handler), deduplicated for 5 minutes, German text.
!engagement_on switches the AI engagement layer on and is switched off automatically at stream end.
Moderation notices in chat can be silenced with !silentban; moderation itself stays active.
